variants.headline: Still in view: assembly votes down government bill
variants.sub: The Assembly has rejected a bill put forward by the government.
variants.body:
Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement. A government bill has been voted down in the Colonial Assembly.

The conduct of {target} warrants examination against the rejected proposal. This paper records the legislative result without adopting an unreported explanation for it or declaring a wider political outcome.

variants.headline: Still in view: a proposal meets its parliamentary limit
variants.sub: A proposed government bill has failed in the Assembly vote.
variants.body:
This story remains under examination, {months_running} months into our coverage of the original event. The Assembly has rejected a bill put forward by the government.

The conduct of {target} warrants examination against the rejected proposal. This paper records the legislative result without adopting an unreported explanation for it or declaring a wider political outcome.
